# Pausen

> Pausen is a free Android app by Approxy-dev for scheduling bedtime curfews, using a warm reading tint, and taking 12-second breathing breaks from scrolling. It works offline on Android 10 and newer.

The app was previously called SleepGuardian Mobile. Its Android package ID is `com.sleepguardian.app`. Bedtime plans and scroll history stay on the device. The app requires no account or internet permission.

## App and installation

- [Official Pausen website](https://pausenapk.vercel.app/)
- [Bedtime and Scroll Pause features](https://pausenapk.vercel.app/#features)
- [Android installation guide and APK details](https://pausenapk.vercel.app/#installation)
- [Privacy notice and Android permissions](https://pausenapk.vercel.app/privacy.html)
